strings.name: Adena Friedman
strings.summary: Friedman joined Nasdaq after political-science and business studies, working in data, strategy and finance. She became Carlyle CFO in 2011 and helped its listing before returning in 2014. Nasdaq CEO since 2017 and chair since 2023, she advanced its technology businesses; in 2026 she was re-elected chair and joined Intuit’s board.
